```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Navigation for Consultation Requests

  Background:
    Given the system is installed and running
    And the user has no computer background

  @VIRTUA-2_5-18
  Scenario: People with no computer background can use the system relatively easily
    When the user accesses the system for the first time
    Then the system should provide clear and simple instructions for navigation
    And the user should be able to complete a Consultation Request without assistance

  @VIRTUA-2_5-19
  Scenario: The system navigation is simple and intuitive
    When the user navigates through the system
    Then the navigation should be straightforward with minimal steps
    And the system should provide clear labels and icons for each section

  @VIRTUA-2_5-20
  Scenario Outline: A normal Consultation Request should get filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given the user starts filling out a Consultation Request
    When the user completes the form with <number_of_questions> relevant questions
    Then the time taken to complete the form should be less than 5 minutes

    Examples:
      | number_of_questions |
      | 5                   |
      | 10                  |
      | 15                  |

  @VIRTUA-2_6-1
  Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared
    When the user accesses the Installation Guide
    Then the guide should provide step-by-step instructions for installing the system
    And the guide should be easy to understand and follow

  @VIRTUA-2_6-2
  Scenario: User Manual for end users is prepared
    When the user accesses the User Manual
    Then the manual should provide clear instructions for using the system
    And the manual should cover all relevant features and functionalities
```
